subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: Should OpenClaw accept any loopback or package-specific device-pairing bypass for the Trim OS package, or require a trace-backed fix that preserves the current Gateway auth/device-pairing contract?
rationale: The reporter is blocked, but the suggested remedies touch Gateway auth boundaries and package-managed config behavior, and current source does not prove which frame or package owner is failing.

options.title: Require trace-backed diagnosis first
options.body: Ask for the redacted connect frame, Gateway close log, exact CLI/Gateway versions, and Trim OS package config-generation evidence before changing core, docs, or package behavior.

options.title: Approve a narrow packaged recovery path
options.body: Allow a documented Trim OS recovery path only if it preserves device auth by default and has explicit security review for loopback-only operation.

options.title: Route package regeneration outside core
options.body: Treat `trim.openclaw` config rewriting as external package administration unless evidence shows an OpenClaw-owned installer or plugin is generating the config.

recommendation.title: Require trace-backed diagnosis first
recommendation.body: Ask for the redacted connect frame, Gateway close log, exact CLI/Gateway versions, and Trim OS package config-generation evidence before changing core, docs, or package behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway auth handshake work makes this the strongest current-main routing signal for the security-sensitive protocol/auth branch.
